Since 17 is prime, Fermat's Little Theorem gives 3^16 ≡ 1 (mod 17). Because 106 = 6·16 + 10, we have 3^106 ≡ 3^10 (mod 17).

Computing powers of 3 mod 17:
- 3^2 = 9
- 3^4 = 81 ≡ 13
- 3^8 ≡ 13² = 169 ≡ 16 ≡ −1

So 3^10 = 3^8 · 3^2 ≡ (−1)(9) = −9 ≡ 8 (mod 17).

The remainder is 8.

- 1 January 1800 was a Wednesday, because 100 years contain 36,524 days, which is 5 days more than a whole number of weeks, so Monday minus 5 days gives Wednesday.
- From 1 January 1800 to 1 January 1803 is 3 × 365 = 1,095 days, because 1800 was not a leap year. That is 3 days more than whole weeks, so 1 January 1803 was a Saturday.
- 13 June is day 164 of a non-leap year (151 days through May, plus 13), so it falls 163 days after 1 January. Since 163 mod 7 = 2, the day is Saturday plus 2, which is Monday.
